one_line: One wrapped gift per beat, each with a named recipient, filmed in warm close-ups.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a hand lights a candle in a stone bowl beside calendars, pens and wafers. Voiceover (transcript): a festive Rosh Chodesh meal in gan is a reason to give gifts. Large subtitles, one word each: "היום", "חגיגית", "חודש".
q1_hook.why: A warm candle-lit flat lay with a voice from 0:00 sets a pleasant mood (H4, H6). But three subtitle words do not say what the Reel is about, and the gift for teachers only shows at 0:09 (against H2, T3). The first image is a lit candle, with the products half out of frame (H1).

beats.what: Candle lit over a flat lay of calendars, pens and wafers; voice on the Rosh Chodesh meal
beats.why: Cosy mood, but the topic is not yet clear

beats.what: A woman on a sofa, seen from the neck down, wraps a planner in a clear bag; "נייר."
beats.why: Shows the making, in dim light

beats.what: Mint weekly planner of 80 pages with a pen, a wafer and a "Thank you" sticker; "לגננת"
beats.why: First gift, with its named recipient

beats.what: A blue floral desk calendar with a wafer and a pen, through a dissolve
A pink wall calendar in its pack, then the back of the pack with a calendar overview
All gifts on the counter beside the candle; subtitles "פלפוט", "שנה", "תכנון", "עטים"
The gift stack dissolves to a floor; "ואת זה תמצאו בכל החנויות הנבחרות."
beats.why: Ends on where to find it, with no store named

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none in the video. Caption: "תודו זו מתנה מושלמת", an invitation to agree.
q2_flow.why: A new gift every 5 to 6 s gives a steady rhythm (R3, E2), and the named recipients make each beat meaningful. But the first 8 s do not say what the Reel is about, and the last third turns from gifts to a brand list read over similar close-ups, a dry stretch (R3, R1).

q3_cta.what: None. The last subtitle, 0:30-0:31: "ואת זה תמצאו בכל החנויות הנבחרות." The caption says the range is in selected stores and ends "תודו זו מתנה מושלמת". No store, link or code.
q3_cta.why: It says where the products are, but names no store and asks for no action, so a viewer cannot act (against C6). "תודו" invites agreement only (C2). The one message repeated in voice, subtitle and caption is at least consistent (C1).

q4_shown.what: A lit candle and a flat lay 0:00-0:03; a woman, neck down, wrapping a planner 0:04-0:07; close-ups of three wrapped gifts with a pen and a wafer 0:08-0:23; all gifts together 0:24-0:29; the brand's logo on the packs. No price, no use.
q4_shown.why: The wrapped gifts are shown one by one, each tied to a named recipient (K7, K2), with the creator's own taste as a first-hand voice (S6). The brand's name is said and shown through the last third (C7, H3), and the products are never shown in use.

q5_edit.what: 7 distinct shots in 32 s (about 4.5 s each), straight cuts and crossfades; handheld close-ups after a static flat lay. One-word large subtitles and small phrases change about every second, about 86 percent down. Ends on a dissolve to a floor.
q5_edit.why: Word-by-word subtitles synced to a continuous voiceover work muted and with sound (E4, T1), and a new item every 5 to 6 s changes the picture (E2). The dissolves and the dim sofa shot soften the middle (E2, F7), and a spoken product list over similar close-ups is dry (R3).

q6_topic.what: Thank-you gifts for kindergarten teachers: planners and calendars with a pen and a sweet, from a mother; it serves parents who want a teacher-gift idea.
q6_topic.why: A recurring parent task with named recipients and a clear buyer (K7, K6), and an idea that is easy to copy and save (R5, R7). The tone is warm, but it is a product list with no turn or peak (K1, K2).

q7_filmed.what: A static top-down flat lay on a stone counter lit by a candle; a handheld medium shot of a woman on a sofa in dim light, cropped at the neck; handheld close-ups of wrapped gifts in warm light; a final dissolve. No face.
q7_filmed.why: A candle-lit counter gives a cosy home look (H8), and the close-ups fill the frame with the products (F4, F5). The sofa shot is dim and low in detail, and several close-ups blur through the dissolves (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in subtitles of the voiceover, white bold sans-serif with a dark shadow, centred about 86 percent down, one large word or a short phrase at a time: "היום" (0:00), "חגיגית" (0:01), "חודש" (0:02), "נייר." (0:07), "לגננת" (0:09), "ירוק" (0:13), "פלפוט" (0:24), "ואת זה תמצאו בכל החנויות הנבחרות." (0:30-0:31). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "היום הילדים חגגו בגן את ראש החודש עם ארוחה חגיגית,". About 80 words in 6 short paragraphs: the occasion, the three gifts, the brand's range "זמין בחנויות הנבחרות", "תודו זו מתנה מושלמת", then the @palphot tag. No question, no hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitling the whole voiceover makes it readable on mute (T1), but one word at a time in the bottom 35% with no headline card means the topic is never named up front (T3, T4). The caption is a story with no hashtags (T7), and the commercial link is a tag, not a Hebrew word (T8).

weak_points: A vague first 8 s that does not say these are teacher gifts; one-word subtitles in the bottom 35%; a dim sofa shot; the brand taking over the last third; no price, store or link; a weak disclosure.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the wrapped book as a teacher gift in warm light, say who it is for in the first line, and name where to buy in the last line.
not_verified: Whether the woman is the account owner or has children in the gan. Music (the voiceover runs throughout; music cannot be told). The machine transcript is partly garbled, so the burned-in subtitles and caption were used. Whether Palphot paid (coauthor and tag, label 0). No corrections to the first pass.
